fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance visible from both directions of travel on the street.
• Mark the rear gate location with a reflective indicator so responders can locate it quickly at night or in low visibility.
• Keep the rear gate unlocked or secured with a breakaway lock to allow responders to reach the detached structure without delay.
• Trim vegetation along the walkway and driveway edges to maintain a clear path wide enough for responders carrying equipment.
• Cut back dense plantings that obstruct sight lines between the main residence and the detached structure.
• Keep the vehicle parking area clear of stored items so responders can use it as a staging area or turn-around point.
• Post the detached structure address or unit identifier on the structure itself so responders can confirm location on arrival.
• Trim shrubs or trees along the perimeter fencing that may block or conceal gate hardware, latches, or access points.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches from large trees that hang close to the house or any outbuildings.
• Thin scattered trees near structures so there is open space between individual tree canopies.
• Remove shrubs and low-growing plants that grow directly against the sides of the house.
• Keep the area under large trees clear of dead leaves, fallen branches, and dry plant material.
• Separate clusters of scattered trees from each other by removing the trees or shrubs that connect them.
• Maintain open ground between tree groupings and the house so there is clear space on all sides.
• Keep all access routes free of low-hanging branches that could block a vehicle or slow movement to the house.
